{{Event Infobox
| Name  = The Woman in Blue
| Image = Event-WomanInBlue.png
}}
{{E|The Woman in Blue}} is a shrine [[Event]] encountered in all [[Acts]].

Shrine events appear less frequently than other events.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Buy 1 Potion}} {{TS|gold||20 Gold.}}

{{Frame|Buy 2 Potions}} {{TS|gold||30 Gold.}}

{{Frame|Buy 3 Potions}} {{TS|gold||40 Gold.}}

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
From the darkness, an arm pulls you into a small shop. As your eyes adjust, you see a pale woman in sharp clothes gesturing to a wall of potions. <br>
"Buy a potion. Now!" she states.
</div>

{{Frame|Buy}} any amount of potions
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Good. Now leave." <br>
You exit the shop cautiously.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
{{TS|negative|shake|WHAM}} <br>
Her gloved fist collides with your face, nearly knocking you off your feet. <br>
"Get out before I litter the floor with your guts." You take her word and exit with your guts still safely in your body.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* Even if you skip grabbing the potions you bought, she will still be satisfied.
